metadata.description: Claude Code mods for everyday workflows

plugins.name: effort-picker
plugins.description: Sets each request's effort level from the task, not the prompt: Claude picks a level once it understands the work, and helpers get a level per job.

plugins.name: plain-language
plugins.description: Claude's chat replies to you in plain, CEFR-level English: no code unless asked, short task reports. Files, reviews and agent hand-offs keep full technical detail.
